scope: incremental event-loop guard; original better-comparator resource targets remain unchanged
comparator_target: Foot/Monstar observed zero voluntary context switches per three-second interval; this target remains zero, not a wakeup measurement.
requirements: Zero repeated application-owned 100 ms poll/ppoll timeouts during settled idle interval in an instrumented diagnostic; exclude startup/shutdown and preserve raw traces.

Three uninstrumented launches per 80x24 and 318x89 using the controlled baseline environment; pooled per-grid median and linear p90 voluntary context-switch deltas must not exceed the fixed values below.
CPU tick-delta median/p90 must not exceed fixed baseline with same measurement resolution.

After-idle RSS/PSS/private maxima may not exceed original per-grid maxima by more than 1 MiB; this predeclared incremental allowance covers fixed host implementation/layout costs and does not change the unmet comparator targets.
Attributed CUDA GPU memory must not exceed 242 MiB at 80x24 or 300 MiB at 318x89. Unknown is not zero.

Private graphical tests must retain direct-child exit status/final output when a daemon owns the PTY, idle close, wake on output, POLLOUT input backpressure, search/resize, synchronized-frame completion/abandonment, and decode input response below existing 50 ms test bound.
Owned control/pid descriptors and worker must close/join on normal exit and exception paths; repeated lifecycle checks must show no surviving window processes.
Nix build/check and Finix preview/evaluator must pass. Preserve CUDA parsing/state/raster and Ekko behavior.
